items.shadow_impact: Attackers front-run legitimate rebalancing operations to control when excess DLF tokens are transferred to the custodian, disrupting the vault's buffer management.
items.reason: The report's front-running/buffer-disruption harm is folded into the custodian_monitoring_disruption statement, but that claim has no P/I/V formula (all expressions null) and is marked unformalized. The front-running control-of-transfer harm is not separately expressed; the only formalized transfer claim (unauthorized_rebalance_completion) covers unauthorized completion, not front-running timing control.

items.shadow_impact: Front-running causes the custodian's off-chain event monitoring system to miss legitimate rebalancing signals.
items.reason: Report states 'causing the custodian's off-chain event monitoring system to miss legitimate rebalancing signals'; the linked claim has no formula and is explicitly unformalized with a semantic-faithfulness mismatch reason. Honest bookkeeping but not completed coverage.

items.shadow_impact: Unlimited spam calls flood TopUpRequestedFromCustodian and ExcessFundsTransferredToCustodian events, creating a denial-of-service vector against the custodian's infrastructure.
items.reason: Claim expresses P (callable by any address, unlimited repeated calls, any-address trigger) and V (custodian_event_flooded) matching the report's spam/event-flood DoS statement; safety I is the no-spam intent. Semantically aligned with cited report text.

items.shadow_impact: Spamming the function griefs the system by flooding event logs and wasting gas.
items.reason: Event-log flooding is captured by custodian_event_flooded in the event_flood_dos claim. The gas-wasting griefing element is not separately modeled (report itself does not quantify it), but the event-flood harm is expressed.

items.shadow_impact: The function performs actual token transfers to the custodian address when the vault is overfunded, and emits events that trigger off-chain custodian actions.
items.reason: Mechanism, not a harm; captured as the transfer/event mechanism underlying unauthorized_rebalance_completion (cfc260822_unauthorized_rebalance_completed includes transferring excess DLF tokens to the custodian).

items.shadow_impact: The function reads live on-chain state (getCollateralUnderCustody()) that can change between calls, making timing critical.
items.reason: Mechanism, not a harm; no coverage row or claim needed, but note it is not represented in any formal claim. Not counted as a harm omission.

omissions_or_errors: custodian_monitoring_disruption (front-running buffer disruption + missed custodian signals) has no formal P/I/V formula; it is unformalized, so the report's central front-running harm lacks completed coverage.
The front-running 'control when excess DLF tokens are transferred' harm is not separately expressed; only unauthorized completion is formalized.
Gas-wasting griefing is mentioned in the report but not modeled as a distinct effect (report does not quantify it).
